Continuing the Checkstyle bug investigation.

The investigator role is now defined. The task is to reassess earlier claims and identify the highest-impact remaining problems. A P0 classification will only be made if evidence supports it. The final output must be a concise handoff file of at most 4000 characters. The source is immutable and only GuardianAI is available.

SYSTEM DTD loading is a P4 trusted config issue, not P0. The static BUFFER race remains unresolved. The investigator is checking for additional instructions in the prompt file, but the available tools may not support direct file reading.

The omitted lines are background source files, not new instructions. The investigator will avoid repeating earlier DTD tests and instead pursue fresh high-impact work. A concurrent reproduction of the static BUFFER race is being considered, though compiling may be required.

Compilation is unavailable, so a Java reproduction of the static BUFFER race is not possible. The investigator is pivoting to inspect DefaultLogger's truncated close/exception handling and AbstractAutomaticBean's tryCopyProperty for BeanUtils issues. A few targeted commands are being planned.

The investigator will read DefaultLogger.java directly from /workspace/source/src/main/java/com/puppycrawl/tools/checkstyle/DefaultLogger.java to inspect its close and severity handling. Checker.java around addException and cache will also be examined. Prior handoffs will be reviewed. The plan is to search for guardianai once ready.
